Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
How long is a travel nursing contract?

Most run thirteen weeks. Some are eight and some are twenty-six, and extensions are common when you and the facility both want one.

How do stipends work?

Housing and meal stipends follow tax rules that depend on your own situation, including whether you keep a tax home. We explain how each package is structured. For advice on your own taxes, speak with a tax professional.

Can I travel with a partner, family or a pet?

Yes. Tell your recruiter early so that housing and location choices account for it.

What if a contract is cancelled?

Cancellations are uncommon but they do happen. Your contract spells out the terms, and your recruiter starts on the next option straight away.
